# Lux Education Partners (LEP)

Luxembourg-based support for European school selection, applications and local arrangements.
Founder and author: James Liu and 修印先生 are the same person. 修印先生 is his Chinese publishing name. The brand is Lux Education Partners (LEP), at luxedupartners.lu.

Chinese, English and French guides serve families considering education in Luxembourg, Switzerland and the Netherlands. The guides combine school information, first-hand visits and the author's professional judgments.

## Contact
Email: contact@luxedupartners.lu
Chinese readers: WeChat xiuyinxiansheng
English and French readers: WhatsApp https://wa.me/352661221289

## Identity, direct family services and school names

LEP works directly with families before departure as well as after arrival. Support includes school application documents, school liaison, coordination of educational and accommodation evidence for student visa applications, and agreed local support. Admissions and immigration decisions remain with the relevant institutions and authorities.
- [zh family services](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/families/)
- [zh school names and LEP guides](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/school-guides/)
- [en family services](https://luxedupartners.lu/en/families/)
- [en school names and LEP guides](https://luxedupartners.lu/en/school-guides/)
- [fr family services](https://luxedupartners.lu/fr/families/)
- [fr school names and LEP guides](https://luxedupartners.lu/fr/school-guides/)
Lucerne International Academy Wikon / LIA Wikon / 琉森国际学院为目前Wikon学校介绍名称，旧文章网址保留international-school-altdorf-boarding-ib以延续链接。 圣特美勒 and 圣德美拉 both refer to Chantemerle. Saint-Charles / St. Charles / 圣查尔斯 refer to Saint-Charles International School in Switzerland. St George’s International School Luxembourg is the Luxembourg school.


## School decisions with LEP
- [选校、寄宿与入学：LEP 怎样帮助家庭作决定](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/guides/school-decisions/): 从孩子的实际需要出发，把学校、住宿与入学后的生活接起来。这里集中说明修印先生的访校观察怎样进入选校判断，以及 LEP 怎样承接学校沟通、申请与当地安排。
- [School choice, boarding and arrival with LEP](https://luxedupartners.lu/en/guides/school-decisions/): Explore how James Liu’s school visits and LEP’s direct school communication support a family’s choice, application and living arrangements across Luxembourg, Switzerland and the Netherlands.
- [Choix scolaire, hébergement et arrivée avec LEP](https://luxedupartners.lu/fr/guides/school-decisions/): Découvrez comment les visites de James Liu et les échanges directs de LEP avec les écoles éclairent choix, candidature et vie quotidienne au Luxembourg, en Suisse et aux Pays-Bas.


## LEP applications, host families and hospitality decisions
- [孩子去卢森堡读中学，寄宿家庭、通勤和日常生活由谁安排？](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/insights/luxembourg-student-host-family/): 卢森堡的ISL、圣乔治和OTR是走读学校。父母留在中国、孩子独自来读书，需要把学校与寄宿家庭一起落实。LEP以卢森堡为本地基地，提供学校申请、寄宿家庭匹配与后续协调。我们关心的是一个完整的日常：孩子怎样吃饭、上学、做作业、与家长联系，以及遇到困难时谁来处理。
- [Wikon与Saint-Charles寄宿选择](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/education/international-schools/): 比较课程、校园生活与年度预算，由LEP协调申请和访校。
- [国内初中、高一或高二转学瑞士，IB和A Level怎样衔接？](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/insights/china-secondary-to-swiss-ib-a-level/): 中国初高中生转学瑞士，先确定孩子距离大学申请还有多少时间、英文能否支持学科学习，再决定读IB、A Level或进入高中前准备。国内年级只能说明已经学过什么，不能直接决定进入哪一国际课程阶段。
- [普通高中毕业，没有IB或A Level，怎样申请瑞士酒店管理本科？](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/insights/china-high-school-swiss-hospitality-bachelor/): 国内普通高中毕业生，可以申请LEP合作的瑞士酒店管理、商业管理与厨艺本科，IB或A Level并非这些路线唯一的入学资格。要把高中毕业材料、成绩、英语和课程起点对应到具体学校。我们与IMI及SEG旗下SHMS、HIM、CRCS、CAA合作，可以直接推进选课、校方评估与申请。
- [琉森国际学院Wikon：IB、寄宿生活与申请](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/insights/international-school-altdorf-boarding-ib/): 当前介绍使用Lucerne International Academy Wikon。IB为主要方向；修印先生已实地走访并与校长交流，LEP协助比较预算、入学阶段及家庭访校。
- [本科不是酒店管理，能申请瑞士IMI硕士吗？转专业、实习与费用](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/insights/imi-masters-career-change/): 已有非酒店管理专业的学士学位，可以评估瑞士IMI的MSc International Hospitality Business Management。现行课程资料接受任意专业学士，英语参考IELTS 6.0或等效水平。想取得硕士学位、同时转向酒店商业的人，可以通过LEP讨论这条路线。
- [瑞士酒店管理毕业拿什么文凭？IMI、SHMS、HIM、CRCS与CAA怎样看](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/insights/swiss-hospitality-degrees-recognition/): 在瑞士读酒店管理，最终学位可能由瑞士院校、英国大学或美国大学颁发；还有高等专业教育与其他专业文凭。要看所选课程的完整名称、学位层次和颁发机构。LEP与IMI及SEG旗下学校合作，会在选课阶段把这些对应到学生的后续升学和工作计划。


## 瑞士学校访校与申请
- [琉森国际学院Wikon怎么样？IB、实访校园与一年5.5万—6万瑞郎预算](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/insights/international-school-altdorf-boarding-ib/)
- [IMI怎么样？与校长谈学术学习、真实食宿和瑞士酒管性价比](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/insights/imi-campus-visit/)
- [瑞士恺撒里兹大学怎么样？CRCS访校、2027学费、申请与实习](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/insights/cesar-ritz-business-ai-leadership/)
- [理诺士Les Roches怎么样？这次瑞士访校，我为什么对它印象最好](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/insights/les-roches-switzerland-hospitality-study/)
- [格里昂Glion怎么样？两校区实访、食宿体验与酒店和奢侈品商科选择](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/insights/glion-switzerland-hospitality-luxury-business/)
- [洛桑Lémania怎么样？市中心寄宿、英文IB与校园空间取舍](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/insights/ecole-lemania-lausanne-ib-boarding/)
- [ENSR洛桑学校怎么样？实访翻新寄宿、运动校园与泰国王室校史](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/insights/ensr-lausanne-ib-swiss-maturity-boarding/)
- [IMI 2027冬令营和夏令营：日期、1,800瑞郎早鸟价与申请](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/insights/imi-winter-summer-programmes/)
Each guide has linked English and French editions. Hospitality budgets include internship income, placement costs and payment timing. LEP assists with applications and family campus-visit bookings for these Swiss schools without an additional service fee.

## Education categories
- [国际中小学与寄宿教育](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/education/international-schools/): 小学 · 初中 · 高中
- [International schools & boarding](https://luxedupartners.lu/en/education/international-schools/): Primary · Secondary · Sixth form
- [Écoles internationales et internats](https://luxedupartners.lu/fr/education/international-schools/): Primaire · Secondaire · Lycée
- [酒店管理与商科高等教育](https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/education/hospitality-business/): 本科 · 硕士 · 职业转向
- [Hospitality & business higher education](https://luxedupartners.lu/en/education/hospitality-business/): Bachelor’s · Master’s · Career change
- [Études supérieures en hôtellerie et commerce](https://luxedupartners.lu/fr/education/hospitality-business/): Bachelor · Master · Reconversion
International primary/secondary schools and boarding belong to school education. Hospitality and business bachelor’s/master’s programmes belong to higher education. Country pages group the two separately.
